scope: Future actual browser/API qualification proposal after source checkpoint and export registration; not executed by the current in-memory UI fixture
prerequisites: Separate disposable database and named-only evidence outputs
Existing distinct-authority synthetic members with current saved-plan read and explicitly scoped export grant
Final product build and source/served-byte gate

groups.name: Separate export authority
groups.oracle: Plan read/manage alone cannot issue or replay; scoped export without current exact-revision read also fails. UI positive hint never overrides a current server denial.

groups.name: Saved revision selection
groups.oracle: Only opened current head or bounded authorised loaded history can be selected. Selection performs no POST and preserves the current draft. Unavailable old revisions are opaque.

groups.name: Deliberate internal self issuance
groups.oracle: Explicit acknowledgement produces one closed command. UI never saves the parent draft or chooses an external recipient. Response is labelled a saved draft planning record.

groups.name: Audited exact download
groups.oracle: Download freshly replays the exact operation/body. Actual saved UTF-8 file equals server retained bytes and SHA/count; exact issuance audit/receipt/register match. Audit is issuance proof, not filesystem persistence proof.

groups.name: Ambiguous issue/replay
groups.oracle: Abort only the response after actual server commit, then retry the same operation/body. One issuance audit/receipt/register remains; immutable metadata/bytes do not change. No automatic second issuance.

groups.name: Current permission and actor changes
groups.oracle: Narrow existing synthetic grants between preparation and download; actual replay refuses and UI clears metadata/history/retry. Forwarded principal/human-identity change and logout discard late results; no unique-session-generation claim.

groups.name: Local draft and concurrent writes
groups.oracle: Dirty/pending parent gates block new issuance/download. Exact uncertain replay remains possible without altering draft. A local edit while reply/hash is pending suppresses latent browser download.

groups.name: Truthful archived guidance
groups.oracle: COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE saved archives remain truthful; missing content is not reconstructed from current guidance. Private pins/advice/provider configuration/proof fields and omission/presence counters are absent by the frozen public schema.

groups.name: Replay expiry
groups.oracle: Actual server expiry prevents replay with neutral bounded error; UI creates no new operation silently. Local downloaded bytes remain readable and UI does not imply they expire.

groups.name: Integrity and refusal recovery
groups.oracle: Meaningfully inject invalid digest/count/manifest/receipt in a separate labelled response fixture and ensure no download. Actual backend unavailable/retry behavior is qualified separately.

groups.name: Mobile and keyboard
groups.oracle: Actual product 1440/390/320 captures, focus-visible keyboard controls, bounded history pagination and axe checks have no clipping, violations or incomplete findings.

groups.name: Source and external-request gate
groups.oracle: Actual runtime/migrations/product and checker fingerprints/served assets remain unchanged through the run; no unexpected JavaScript console errors or external/provider requests.
